The Sea of Tiberias (θάλασσα τῆς Τιβεριάδος)

Only John names the lake after Tiberias: the feeding of the five thousand is across "the Sea of Galilee, of Tiberias" (6:1), boats come "from Tiberias" (6:23), and the risen Jesus shows himself "by the Sea of Tiberias" (21:1).

  • John 6:1: the Sea of Galilee, of Tiberias.
  • John 6:23: But small boats came from Tiberias
  • John 21:1: by the Sea of Tiberias.

Across the sea (πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης)

The phrase marks every move in John 6: Jesus goes across the sea (6:1); the disciples set out across the sea (6:17); the crowd stands across the sea (6:22) and finds him across the sea (6:25).

  • John 6:1: to the other side of the Sea
  • John 6:17: across the sea
  • John 6:22: on the other side of the sea
  • John 6:25: on the other side of the sea,
